label: D1 early in episode, after reward, while the agent favours a1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (94% of mass; never at GO, a little at D2). It is restricted to the first ~30 trials of an episode: rate 6% in trials 0-9, 4.5% in 10-19, 1.6% in 20-29, and zero from trial 40 on. Among those D1 steps it prefers ones where the agent leans toward a1 (policy logit a1-a2 > 2; previous choice a1 gives 77% of mass, previous a2 almost none), episodes that start with S1 good (89% of mass), and a rewarded previous trial (in_rew=1, 78% of mass). The value head is in a narrow mid band (7.5-7.7). The predicate uses only observed or self-computed quantities: the trial index, which the agent can track implicitly, the current reward input, and its own policy logit. Precision stays near 0.3: many early a1-leaning rewarded D1 steps are inactive, and I could not find what decides which of them fire. So this is an early-episode a1-preference D1 unit and the description is incomplete. I did not check what modulates magnitude.
